entries.proposition: Trimethadione is described as an oxazolidinedione derivative whose anti-seizure activity is attributed to inhibiting T-type calcium channels by citation; no channel current was measured in this paper.
entries.snippet: we tested trimethadione (TMZ), an oxazolidinedione derivative, which possesses anti-seizure activity by inhibiting T-type VGCCs (Zamponi et al., 2009).
